C12 and C08 closely parallel the standard transmission and closing language, but their substantive sequences are less similar.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress a proposed supplemental appropriation for the fiscal year 1954 in the amount of $150,000,000","parent_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress, a proposed supplemental appropriation for Fiscal Year 1952 in the amount of $300,000.","explanation":"Nearly verbatim opening formula with the same singular appropriation request, fiscal-year specification, and stated amount."},{"child_excerpt":"urgent necessity for immediate consideration of an appropriation of funds to implement the administration bill which I have signed","parent_excerpt":"This sum is urgently needed so that the Federal Trade Commission can begin a full-scale effort to enforce Public Law 899 ... which I signed on December 29, 1950","explanation":"Both justify the supplemental request as urgently needed funding to put recently signed legislation into operation."},{"child_excerpt":"Details of the proposed supplemental appropriation are set forth in the attached letter from the Director of the Bureau of the Budget","parent_excerpt":"Details of this appropriation estimate are set forth in the attached letter from the Director of the Bureau of the Budget.","explanation":"The closing administrative formula is substantially identical."}]}
